node.label: Equinus calcaneus
node.definition: Abnormal plantar flexion of the calcaneus relative to the longitudinal axis of the tibia. This results in the angle between the long axis of the tibia and the long axis of the heel bone (calcaneus) being greater than 90 degrees.

evidence.snippet: Mitochondrial trifunctional protein deficiency: Equinus calcaneus (frequency HP:0040283) [TAS]
